thread:
leigh-marketing: Hey team — we wrapped the IntercomX pilot. Can we schedule a short interview next week for a customer story + pull a quote? I'll own the narrative and draft Qs. :white_check_mark:
sam-legal: Quick heads up — need signed consent for quotes and logo use. Also, do we have their PR contact?
leigh-marketing: Yes — PR contact is @carlos at IntercomX (they gave green light in principle). I'll send the intake form.
tom-sales: FYI IntercomX mentioned 3x latency reduction and 40% TCO drop during pilot. Want to make sure those numbers are approved by their engineering lead before we publish.
jess-product: Can you capture the exact test conditions? sequence length, model variant, and batching config. Otherwise the metric is not reproducible.
oliver-cs: I can join the interview for 15m to confirm infra details. Proposed quote draft below — please edit:
```
"Switching to Redwood Inference cut our inference latency by ~3x and reduced per-request cost by ~40%, enabling interactive features at scale." — Alex (IntercomX)
```
ana-marketing: Nice. Can we get approval on that exact wording from IntercomX legal before using it on the website? Also planning a short LinkedIn post + a webinar tie-in.
zoe-growth: Webinar idea: "Real-time LLM at scale: IntercomX case study" — co-present with their Eng PM. We'll route inbound registrants to AE team (tom). Can we add a CTA that tags Dedicated/Private interest?
tom-sales: Yes please. Add a checkbox on the registration form: "I want to discuss Dedicated/Private deployment" so leads flag correctly.
lauren-legal: I reviewed the quote draft. Two edits: remove the exact percent unless they confirm via email, and include a fair-use clause for log snippets. I'll send a one-paragraph consent template.
leigh-marketing: Got it — we'll ask them to confirm the numbers live on the call. I'll update the intake doc: https://docs.redwood/inbox/intercomx-case-study (draft)
sam-legal: Put their legal contact on the doc access and lock commenting until consent is signed.
ana-marketing: Draft social caption ready — please quick review: "IntercomX reduced latency and cost with Redwood Inference — learn how in our upcoming webinar. Register: link" Thoughts? :eyes:
jess-product: Sounds fine but replace "reduced" with "reported" until numbers are confirmed.
leigh-marketing: Will do. Interview slots I proposed in the doc: Tue/Wed 10-11am PT. @oliver-cs @tom-sales can you confirm?
oliver-cs: Tue works for me.
tom-sales: Wed preferred but I can move to Tue if needed.
calendar-bot: Invitation sent to participants for Tue 10:00-10:30 PT — meeting link included.
leigh-marketing: Great — after the interview I'll pull 2 short quote options and circulate for legal and customer sign-off. Then we'll finalize webinar copy + landing page.
ana-marketing: I'll set up the registration form with the Dedicated/Private checkbox and a field to route to AE. Draft landing page in /marketing/case-studies/intercomx (will share).
lauren-legal: Once they return signed consent, ok to run the social/webinar collateral. Keep me in CC for the final sign-off.
leigh-marketing: Thanks all — pushing this through this week. :rocket:
